{{Quote|We expand and bring new voices to the enclave. Your gifts unite us, and we grow to understand that we work best as one.|Sana-Rae speaks to the Commander|<ref name="Vigilant">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|We will stay vigilant.|Sana-Rae}}</ref>}}
The '''Force Enclave''' was a branch of the [[Eternal Alliance]] that was founded around [[3631 BBY]] with the intention to train [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. But members were not trained as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] so much as neutral practitioners that were instructed to connect to the Force itself rather than Jedi or Sith philosophies. The intention was further extended to the need for its recruits to learn both sides to the Force in order to achieve a perfect balance.<ref name="KOTFE" />

The enclave's leader [[Sana-Rae]], believed in perfect and harmonious balance in the Force's two aspects and decided to balance both Jedi and Sith principles into one cohesive platform. Per this plan based upon her vision she also attracted several other [[Voss (species)|Voss]] to train at the enclave with her. Sana-Rae enlisted [[Alliance Commander|the Commander's]] aid in expanding the enclave and in acquiring different artifacts and relics that could help instruct them in their studies.<ref name="KOTFE" />

The enclave was asked to monitor for any remaining signs of [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] in the aftermath of [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|Valkorion's final defeat]], which Sana-Rae found to be a sound precaution.<ref name="Vigilant" />
